description: Stable client-facing contract for Alicia mobile RAG integration. Mobile renders plans and confirms typed cloud tasks; it never interprets or dispatches RAG-generated write routes.
clientResponsibilities: Never execute a mutating backendActionDraft or interpret its method, path, query, or body.
Require visible user confirmation for all mutating actions.
Use the current app login Authorization when calling RAG, ragExecution, and the existing client file-upload API.
Confirm mutations only through executionReference and reject missing, stale, or mismatched cloud task identifiers.
Treat RAG output as a plan, not as proof that an operation has completed.
Use candidateBinding.pageInfo.totalCount only when present; otherwise label the list by its displayed count.
Do not present local expansion as loading all server results when candidateBinding.pageInfo.hasMore is true.
Refresh file and trash views only after ragExecution reports a successful terminal task.

fields.totalCount: Exact server-side total when known; null means unknown.
fields.returnedCount: Number of candidates included in this response.
fields.hasMore: True when the server has additional results; null means unknown.
fields.sortBy: Deterministic server sort field when known.
fields.sortDirection: asc or desc when sortBy is present.

localModules.name: RagAssistantClient
localModules.responsibility: Call /api/assistant/plan and decode the stable response fields.

localModules.name: RagConversationStore
localModules.responsibility: Persist conversationId, pending candidates, and pending review state in ViewModel state.

localModules.name: RagExecutionClient
localModules.responsibility: Confirm, cancel, and query the immutable cloud task identified by executionReference; never accept arbitrary routes from model output.

localModules.name: RagReviewPresenter
localModules.responsibility: Build read-only plan, candidate selection, client upload, and final confirmation presentation models for mobile UI.

none.notes: Persona, product Q&A, out-of-scope, and fallback replies.

search.notes: RAG performs read-only binding through CloudStorageApi; mobile shows candidateBinding or actionPlan bindings.

rename.notes: Mobile displays the review and confirms executionReference; ragExecution dispatches the typed action to CloudStorageApi.

delete.notes: Always move to trash in phase 1; permanent delete stays disabled.

share.notes: Share options may be adjusted by review UI before submit.

folder.create.notes: RAG resolves the target parent directory, mobile confirms executionReference, and ragExecution calls CloudStorageApi after server-side authorization.

upload_target.notes: RAG resolves the target folder. Mobile may upload local file bytes only when an existing cloud task reaches WAITING_CLIENT_INPUT; it never executes backendActionDraft.

composite.create_folder_then_upload.notes: ragExecution creates the folder and moves the task to WAITING_CLIENT_INPUT; mobile then uploads selected bytes to the server-returned parentId and reports completion.

collection.trash_by_name_contains.notes: Mobile shows exact count, filter summary, preview rows, and incomplete-preview blocking text before any submit; execution remains controlled by the environment feature flag.

collection.trash_by_category.notes: Mobile shows exact count, filter summary, preview rows, and incomplete-preview blocking text before any submit; execution remains controlled by the environment feature flag.

collection.move_by_category.notes: Mobile shows the exact category-matched source set and target folder before final confirmation.

collection.move_by_extension.notes: Mobile shows exact source count, filter summary, preview rows, and resolved target folder before any submit; execution remains controlled by the environment feature flag.

collection.move_exact.notes: A single file or folder is represented as an exact one-item source collection and uses the same fully validated batch move endpoint.

collection.move_by_name_contains.notes: Mobile shows exact source count, filter summary, preview rows, and resolved target folder before any submit; execution remains controlled by the environment feature flag.

collection.move.notes: Executes a server-bound source_selector_v2 snapshot after role-specific source and destination binding.

collection.trash.notes: Executes a server-bound source_selector_v2 snapshot after exact collection review.

collection.trash_scoped.notes: Executes a source_selector_v2 snapshot only after the backend revalidates the exact source scope and folder-subtree impact fingerprints.

collection.rename_add_prefix.notes: Mobile shows the complete old/new name preview, validates the allowlist draft, and submits one transactional batch rename request after final confirmation.

preMobileIntegrationGates: Debug web validates all automated acceptance scenarios.
Every mutating response uses an immutable executionReference; public backendActionDraft route material is redacted.
The Android source and BuildConfig contain no local RAG write executor or legacy execution switch.
RAG service base URL and Authorization forwarding are configurable per environment.
DeepSeek API key is supplied through environment variables and not committed.
Destructive actions show candidate path, count, and final confirmation.
